sources.title: Angelegenheiten des Niederlassungs- und Aufenthaltsgesetzes § 1
sources.evidence: RIS page is consolidated to 22 August 2026 but reports its last update as 22 September 2011. It delegates first-instance Landeshauptmann decisions involving Aufenthaltstitel and lists registration certificates under NAG §53 and Daueraufenthaltskarten under §54. Current NAG places Daueraufenthaltskarten under §54a and Aufenthaltskarten under §54; the delegated-document list therefore has a material stale cross-reference and does not establish the current ordinary residence-card route.
